keyVerseDR: "...this poor widow hath cast in more than all they who have cast into the treasury." (Mk 12:43)

level1.title: The Widow's Gift
level1.story: Jesus watched people put money in the Temple box. Rich people gave a lot. A poor widow gave two small coins, all she had. Jesus said she gave the most!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How many coins did the woman give?
level1.prayer: God, I give You everything. Amen.

activity.title: I give God my all
activity.intro: The widow gave everything. Fill the heart with fingerprints.
activity.label: I give God my all

level2.title: The Widow's Mite
level2.story: Jesus warned the people to beware of the scribes who love to walk in long robes and have the first seats. Then He sat near the treasury and watched the crowd putting in money. Many rich people put in a lot. A poor widow came and put in two mites, which make a farthing. Jesus said, "This poor widow hath cast in more than all," because she gave out of her poverty all that she had.
level2.keyLine: This poor widow hath cast in more than all.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did her small gift count most?
What can you give that costs you something?
level2.prayer: Lord, help me give with my whole heart. Amen.

activity.title: My blessings
activity.intro: The widow gave all to God. Write 5 blessings God gave you.
